newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers Friday were steady in a light test, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said.
Trade swas low and demand light to moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light and current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs few 72.00-73.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1175 lbs few 72.00-73.50.
Most cattle delivered to packing plants with weighing conditions equivalent to 3 percent shrink at feedlots with some being bought on a picked up (FOB) basis.
